name: How long does a typical bathtub replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathtub replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathtub replacement project can vary depending on the complexity of the job. A straightforward swap, where the new tub fits the existing space and plumbing, might take 1 to 3 days. However, if plumbing modifications are needed, tiling needs to be replaced, or the surrounding area requires significant repairs or structural changes, the project could extend to 5 to 7 days or even longer. Factors like the type of tub, site conditions, and any unforeseen issues can also influence the timeline. We will provide a more precise estimate after a site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A straightforward replacement typically takes 1 to 3 days. Projects involving plumbing changes or significant renovations can take 5 to 7 days or more.
